jess (AE): Heads-up — DarkHorse asks for a POC: sustained 1k RPS chat workload, avg payload ~8 tokens, target 95th <= 200ms. They need runbook, heatmap, and a cost delta for reserved vs burst capacity. Can we do this next week?
elaine (SE): We can. Model question: do they want highest quality (llama-3-70b quantized) or a smaller variant (redwood-open-7b) to hit latency? Recommendation: run both as canary/fallback and compare tail.
omar (SRE): Clarify infra: multi-AZ? KMS/HSM requirement? Sustained 1k RPS will need warm KV cache and steady batching. Expect 3-4 warm GPUs for 70b q4x, less for 7b. Also watch token distribution spikes.
jess (AE): They require SOC2 + HSM in-region (us-west2). Multi-AZ desirable for SLA. Also they'll want a short security questionnaire answered.
mike (Sales Ops): Quick pricing note: reserved commit will give best unit cost. Back-of-envelope calc: 1k rps * 3600s = 3.6M req/hr, but we need tokens/sec. Let's capture typical tokens/req then I'll produce two pricing lines (monthly reserved vs on-demand burst).
elaine (SE): For the load run, use poisson arrivals and real prompt traces for realism. Example internal load generator command:
```
# run 30m poisson arrival to capture tail
rdw-loadgen --target http://redwood-staging/dgen \ 
  --model redwood-70b-q4 --qps 1000 --duration 30m \ 
  --arrival poisson --pfx-cache warm --sample-prompts prompts.json
```
Collect: p95/p99/p999 latency, CPU/GPU util, KV hit ratio, batch sizes.
omar (SRE): Add: enable per-request trace headers so we can map latency spikes to batching or network. Also schedule a 15m warmup before samples to prime caches. If multi-AZ, we'll do cross-az failover in a second run.
ci-bot: deploy scheduled by infra-bot for redwood-staging at 2026-03-25T09:00Z — will post results artifact link when done. :white_check_mark:
jess (AE): Action items — who owns what? Need: 1) runbook + smoke run (SE), 2) cost calc + quote (Sales Ops), 3) security questionnaire + HSM validation (SRE), 4) run results writeup + heatmap (SE).
elaine (SE): I’ll own runbook + smoke + results writeup. Plan: run a 1h sanity run Wed, 30m stress Poisson Thu, deliver heatmap + latency waterfall by Thu EOD.
mike (Sales Ops): I’ll draft reserved vs burst pricing and a short note on commit sizes needed for 95th cost target. Will share numbers after we get token/req sample.
omar (SRE): I’ll validate HSM in us-west2 and run the security checklist. If HSM causes <5% added latency in path, we'll document it and propose a fallback (customer-managed KMS).
jess (AE): Perfect. @elaine please ping this thread with the rdw-loadgen command output and p99 heatmap. @mike share the pricing doc in same thread. Thanks team :pray: 
infra-bot: artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/darkhorse/bench/1768004321/results.tar.gz
elaine (SE): Noted — will post short run notes + `results.json` link after the smoke. Expect raw results + a one-page summary for the prospect.
jess (AE): Closing loop: timeline looks good. We'll include a short note about fallback routing to 7b for peak tail mitigation in the writeup.
mike (Sales Ops): ACK — will prepare two slides: reserved commit vs burst estimate and short run-rate sensitivity.
omar (SRE): I'll flag any enterprise blockers here. If HSM needs extra certs, raise to legal.
jess (AE): Thanks all — next update after smoke run. :rocket:
